jobs.description:
• Conceptualized and developed a desktop application to centralize financial management and inventory for a vehicle dealership.
• Built the system with Electron, Node.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, running locally on Windows.
• Implemented accounts payable and receivable, inventory, customers, images, backup, and restoration features for owner and secretary use.

Focused on modernizing the web system for process management and institutional scheduling.
• Full-stack platform development using PHP, MySQL, and Bootstrap.
• 40% reduction in screening time via document digitization and indexing.
• Advanced security: SQL Injection protection (Prepared Statements), password encryption, and access control (RBAC).
Development of scalable systems, including offline management platforms with Electron and modern web applications using Next.js, Node.js, and relational databases.
